recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core-spec work is needed for FHIR-14237 unless FHIR-I separately decides to add more illustrative examples beyond the applied normative and explanatory guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-14237 was a Published FHIR-core search-page change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for STU3. It asked for examples and guidance on token search use for ContactPoint, uri, and boolean; the final resolution required pipe syntax to be an error for those target datatypes and ContactPoint token searches to allow server-specific handling such as ignoring punctuation or partial phone matching.
initial_application: Commit 43a29baf1630997360326c7e79c7ca11b7e40def, corresponding to svn revision 13072, applied GF#14237 by changing source/search.html to add the no-pipe rule for ContactPoint, uri, and boolean token targets and the ContactPoint special-handling narrative.
additional_context: source/search.html is the active FHIR-core search narrative named by the Jira related page, and source/fhir.ini has active [search-rules] entries mapping boolean, uri, and ContactPoint to token behavior. FHIR-8121 is supporting background for broader server search discretion, and later FHIR-37990 validly added id to the same no-pipe note and is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/search.html already says the URI/system portion is not used for uri, boolean, ContactPoint, and id token targets; its conformance note says token parameters on ContactPoint, uri, and boolean SHALL NOT use the pipe symbol; and its ContactPoint row permits special handling such as ignoring punctuation or performing partial searches.

related_jiras.note: Broader advanced-search discretion cited by a FHIR-14237 Jira comment and already reflected in the current search page.
